en.title: Valid Passwords
en.description:
A password has length n, contains only lowercase English letters, and must not contain k consecutive identical characters. Count the distinct valid passwords modulo 1,000,000,007.

See below for this site's input/output protocol; the source repository's solution is not executed.
en.output: Output the total number of valid passwords modulo 1,000,000,007.
en.explanation: The source constraint k≤n is kept; boundary tests cover k=2 and k=n.
